data.title: 史尔特尔 · 赤岩礁滩的冰淇淋小憩
data.action: 单脚踩在岩石上，一手拿冰淇淋甜筒轻尝，另一手叉腰侧视
data.location: 烈日灼晒的红色岩礁浅水湾
data.lighting: 强烈明朗的日光与赤色岩石投下的硬朗阴影
data.camera: cowboy shot, low angle, 礁石七分身低角度仰视，烈日下吃冰淇淋神态清晰
data.description: 正午烈日烤炙的赤色礁石浅湾，海水在热浪下波光粼粼。史尔特尔单脚踏在滚烫的平整岩壁上，一手拿着双球树莓冰淇淋甜筒小心品尝，另一手叉腰。察觉到目光后挑起红瞳冷冷瞥来，嘴里虽抱怨着炎热，手里的甜食却丝毫没有放下的意思。
data.promptProse: Standing upon sun-warmed red sea rocks at a coastal cove under brilliant midday sun, Surtr holds a double-scoop raspberry ice cream cone, looking sideways with cool pride. Clear direct sunlight reflects off the shallow blue water and casts sharp shadows against the rocky shore.
data.animaCaption: Holding an ice cream cone on the coastal sunlit rocks, she glances sideways with cool confidence under the bright midday sky.
